pages.text: Use each checkpoint in the order the compass gives. The first checkpoint seals the party.
pages.title: Checkpoints
Wake the instrument
pages.text: A checkpoint banks part of the guaranteed token reward for every member. Those secured tokens survive failure. Completion settles what remains, including earned bonuses.

pages.title: Wake the instrument
pages.text: A horde may answer the activation. Expect creatures that belong to this dimension's biome, including unfamiliar ones.

pages.title: What failure costs
pages.text: Death removes a member from the expedition. The last member lost fails the run. You keep tokens already secured at checkpoints; unfinished bonuses remain at risk.

pages.title: What failure costs
pages.text: Disconnecting leaves the run resumable. On return, every marker and the dimension itself must still exist. Missing pieces fail the expedition safely.

pages.title: What failure costs
pages.text: Extraction, not the final checkpoint, ends the journey.
